passages.title: Mindset 0 · Unit 6 — Signs, notices and messages
passages.content:
Read the signs and messages.

1 — Notice
PARKING FOR SUPERMARKET CUSTOMERS ONLY. Free for two hours – after that £2 an hour.

2 — Message
Hi Tom, Jim and I are playing football in the park today. Do you want to join us? We'll get on the bus at the town centre at 12:30pm. Let me know, Harry

3 — Notice
Trains travelling north out of this station are delayed because of heavy snow.

4 — Email (To: Su, From: Lee, Subject: Holiday plans)
I just checked and there are seats available on the flight we want. Let's book them soon before the price gets too expensive!

5 — Postcard
Hi Deon, I went sightseeing around the city today on an open top bus. We visited the museum and the castle along the way. We're going on a boat trip tomorrow and we'll be back home on Friday. George

6 — Notice (Milltown Station)
Bicycles should be left in the bicycle stands only. For advice, please speak to a member of staff, who can give more details.

7 — Message
Alice, how are you going to the theatre tonight? It's close enough for me to walk but Tim's going by car and he's offered to drive me. Let him know if you want him to drive you, too. Sonia

questionGroups.instruction: Read the signs and messages again. Choose the correct answer, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: What does the supermarket notice say?
options: You can pay £2 to leave your car in the supermarket car park all day.
Supermarket customers can only park here for 2 hours at a time.
You don't need to pay if you finish shopping within 2 hours.
questions.explanation: "Free for two hours – after that £2 an hour" → mua sắm xong trong 2 tiếng thì không mất tiền. A sai (£2 MỖI GIỜ, không phải cả ngày); B sai (có thể đỗ lâu hơn nếu trả tiền). MINI TIP 06.1.

questions.questionText: Why did Harry write this message?
options: To give Tom and Jim instructions on how to get to the park.
To invite Tom to play football with him and Jim.
To find out what time Tom would like to play football.
questions.explanation: "Do you want to join us?" = lời mời. Thông tin về xe buýt và giờ chỉ là chi tiết (MINI TIP 06.2).

questions.questionText: What is the notice telling passengers?
options: They should wait for news about the weather before travelling.
Some passengers will be late today because of the weather.
The station is closed until the weather improves.
questions.explanation: "Trains travelling north… are delayed because of heavy snow" → một số (đi về phía bắc) sẽ đến muộn. Ga không đóng cửa (C).

options: To book the flights as soon as possible.
To choose a less expensive flight.
To change the date of his and Su's flight.
questions.explanation: "Let's book them soon before the price gets too expensive!" → đặt sớm.

options: His sightseeing trip included a visit to a museum and castle.
He visited the castle and museum after going on the boat trip.
He hopes to do a boat trip and an open bus tour before returning home.
questions.explanation: "We visited the museum and the castle along the way" (trong chuyến xe buýt). Boat trip là NGÀY MAI → B sai; xe buýt đã đi rồi → C sai.

questions.questionText: What are train passengers told at the station?
options: They must not leave bikes at the station.
Cycle parking is only for members of station staff.
If they need to know more, they can ask someone who works there.
questions.explanation: "For advice, please speak to a member of staff, who can give more details" → hỏi nhân viên. Được để xe ở chỗ để xe (A sai).

options: Contact Tim if she would like a lift to the theatre.
Tell Sonia what her travel plans are for this evening.
Let Tim or Sonia know if she's going to the theatre.
questions.explanation: "Let **him** know if you want him to drive you" → liên hệ Tim nếu muốn đi nhờ xe.

sections.title: Mindset 0 · Unit 6 — Northfields' Shopping Centre (Part 1)
sections.description: Information about a new shopping centre — Part 1.
sections.transcript:
Presenter: Hello everyone and welcome to this talk about Northfields' Shopping Centre. It opens next weekend and I'm very excited to be able to tell you about it tonight. It's a beautiful building, full of light and colour and a wonderful place to spend time in. It was designed by a prize-winning architect – John Gadzen. That's G-A-D-Z-E-N. Have a look at his website – he's done some fantastic work.
Northfields is just outside town, on Forest Drive. If you're coming by car and want to use your sat nav, then the postcode is WT3 5BX. That's the easiest way to do it; it works better than using the address.
We are open seven days a week, and our opening hours are ten am until six pm every day except Thursday. That's when we have late-night shopping until 8:00 pm. We're planning to open late on Wednesdays too, but that won't happen until we see how popular the centre is.
There are lots of ways to get to us. We have a large car park, which at the moment is free to use. You can also come by bus from the town centre. Bus 635 brings you to the entrance. There's also bus 729, but that stops further away and it's a five-minute walk to the shopping centre. And of course, you can use the underground. A ticket from town is only £3.50. The bus costs £2.00, so the underground is a bit more expensive but much faster. From the town centre, it only takes fifteen minutes!

questionGroups.instruction: Listen and complete the information. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

noteConfig.title: Northfields' shopping centre information
lines: Name of architect who designed Northfields': John __Q1__
Transport — By car: free car park
Underground: from the town centre it only takes __Q5__ minutes

questions.explanation:
Dịch: Tên kiến trúc sư: John ___

Vị trí: Đầu bài.

Transcript: “John Gadzen. That's G-A-D-Z-E-N”

Phân tích: Tên được đánh vần — nghe từng chữ cái.

Dịch: Địa chỉ và mã bưu chính: Forest Drive, ___

Vị trí: Khi nói về sat nav.

Transcript: “the postcode is WT3 5BX”

Phân tích: Mã bưu chính Anh: chữ + số.

Dịch: Mua sắm muộn tới 8pm vào ___

Vị trí: Phần giờ mở cửa.

Transcript: “every day except Thursday. That's when we have late-night shopping until 8:00 pm” … “We're planning to open late on Wednesdays too, but that won't happen until…”

Phân tích: BẪY: thứ Tư chỉ là kế hoạch tương lai → Thursday.

Dịch: Có ___ tuyến xe buýt

Vị trí: Phần giao thông.

Transcript: “Bus 635 brings you to the entrance” … “There's also bus 729”

Phân tích: Hai tuyến 635 và 729 → 2. Đừng ghi số tuyến.

Dịch: Tàu điện ngầm từ trung tâm chỉ mất ___ phút

Vị trí: Cuối Part 1.

Transcript: “From the town centre, it only takes fifteen minutes!”

Phân tích: £3.50 là giá vé, £2.00 là giá xe buýt → 15.

sections.title: Mindset 0 · Unit 6 — Northfields' Shopping Centre (Part 2)
sections.description: Information about a new shopping centre — Part 2: the map.
sections.transcript:
Presenter: OK, now let me show you a map of the shopping centre. As you can see, there are two floors. On the first floor there's a cinema, where you can see some great movies. And opposite that, in a smaller area, there are lots of places to eat and drink. There are fast-food restaurants as well, if you don't have time to sit and eat.
All the shops are on the ground floor. The biggest shop is the supermarket. If you use the car park entrance, it's the last shop on your right. Then, all the way over on the other side of the building, is the second biggest shop – Green's department store. You can get almost anything in there, including gifts, things for the kitchen, and furniture.
Also on the ground floor is a pharmacy selling medicine, and health and beauty products. You'll find it between the men's and women's clothes shop and the café. Male and female toilets are also on this floor, which is on the same side as the café. There's also a great book store selling everything you might need for school. If you're coming from the car park entrance, that's the second shop on your right, next to the sports shop. Oh, and if you need a mobile phone, that's the smallest shop in the shopping centre – between the bank and the shoe shop. You can get all the latest mobile phones there. So I hope you'll all visit Northfields' soon and that you'll have a great time here!

questionGroups.instruction: Look at the map of Northfields' shopping centre. Listen and choose the correct letter, A–F, for each place.

questions.explanation:
Dịch: rạp chiếu phim

Vị trí: Đầu Part 2.

Transcript: “On the first floor there's a cinema”

Phân tích: Tầng 1 có 2 khu: khu nhỏ là Cafés and Restaurants (đã ghi), khu còn lại là F.

Dịch: siêu thị

Vị trí: Phần tầng trệt.

Transcript: “The biggest shop is the supermarket. If you use the car park entrance, it's the last shop on your right”

Phân tích: Cửa hàng lớn nhất, cuối cùng bên phải từ lối vào bãi đỗ xe → C.

Dịch: cửa hàng bách hoá Green's

Vị trí: Ngay sau siêu thị.

Transcript: “all the way over on the other side of the building, is the second biggest shop”

Phân tích: Phía bên kia toà nhà, lớn thứ hai → A.

Dịch: hiệu thuốc

Vị trí: Giữa Part 2.

Transcript: “You'll find it between the men's and women's clothes shop and the café”

Phân tích: Giữa cửa hàng thời trang và quán cà phê → E.

Dịch: hiệu sách

Vị trí: Gần cuối.

Transcript: “If you're coming from the car park entrance, that's the second shop on your right, next to the sports shop”

Phân tích: Cạnh Sports shop → B.

Dịch: cửa hàng điện thoại

Vị trí: Cuối bài.

Transcript: “that's the smallest shop in the shopping centre – between the bank and the shoe shop”

Phân tích: Giữa Bank và Shoes → D.
